SFRPGWEAPONFX.EnableHint: Play a JB2A effect when you roll weapon damage with one or more targets selected. Weapons with no damage parts, such as smoke grenades, play on the attack roll instead.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.ScaleHint: Multiplies the size of impacts, clouds, and melee swipes. Critical damage adds another 25 percent.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.DebugHint: Write effect choices, audiences, and skipped rolls to the browser console.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.EnableSoundsHint: Play a short sound with each weapon effect. Sounds use Foundry's environment volume.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.VolumeHint: World volume for weapon sounds, from 0 to 1, before Foundry's environment slider.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.PrivacyHint: Restrict effects to the audience of a whispered, blind, or self-only card. GMs always see their own effects.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.ClientEnableHint: Turn effects off on this client without changing the world setting.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.ClientScaleHint: Personal multiplier applied after the world scale. Values are clamped to 0.5-2.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.ClientVolumeHint: Personal multiplier applied after the world volume. Values are clamped to 0-1.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.ClientSoundsHint: Turn weapon and spell sounds off on this client.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.IntensityHint: Low reduces critical volleys and particles; high adds more. Ordinary single attacks are unchanged.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.OnlyMyRollsHint: Skip weapon effects caused by another player's rolls on this client.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.NotifySkipsName: Notify when an effect is skipped
SFRPGWEAPONFX.NotifySkipsHint: Show one throttled notice for no target, no source token, private cards, or missing assets.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.PreloadHint: Ask Sequencer to preload common weapon clips for clients when the world loads.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.MissingSequencer: Starfinder Weapon FX requires the Sequencer module. Weapon animations are disabled.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.SequencerNotReady: Sequencer is active but not ready yet. Effects will start after the canvas is ready.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.MissingJB2A: Starfinder Weapon FX needs JB2A Free or JB2A Patreon before weapon effects can play.
SFRPGWEAPONFX.PreviewMissingItem: No matching item to preview. Pass an item UUID, an item name, or an item object.
